**POST — `/home/daniel/.../src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`**

- **`BuildOwner.java`** — POST: maps `OwnerFieldsDto` → `Owner` via `OwnerMapper`, defaults `registrationDate` to today, outputs `Out<Owner>`. Does **not** normalize telephone.

- **`ApplyOwner.java`** — PUT: copies address, city, firstName, lastName, telephone from the request DTO onto the loaded `Owner`. (Does not touch email; no uniqueness check.)

- **`RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`** (POST 201), **`RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java`** (PUT), **`RespondWithOwner.java`** (GET).
- Others not in these two pipelines: `ListOwners`, `ListOwnersPage`, `DeleteOwner`, `BuildOwnersPet`, `LoadOwnersPet`, `AssignCustomerCode`.

## 5. Tests for owners and telephone

**Acceptance tests** (`/home/daniel/.../src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`), all extending `AcceptanceBase.java`:
- **`Cp02Tests.java`** — cp02: reject new owner with same last name AND telephone (409); allows same last name + different telephone.
- **`Cp03Tests.java`** — cp03: telephone must be unique across all owners (409); distinct telephones allowed.
- **`Cp05Tests.java`** — cp05: duplicate detection ignores letter case (household duplicate via same telephone).
- **`Cp11Tests.java`** — cp11: expects telephone **stored digits-only** (`coreStoresDigitsOnly` posts `(608) 555-1023`, expects stored `6085551023`) and **punctuation-normalized before the uniqueness check** (`functionalityNormalisedDuplicateRejected` expects 409 for same digits with punctuation). **This behavior is NOT currently implemented** — both the `OwnerFieldsDto` pattern `^[0-9]*$` and the `Owner` entity pattern `^[0-9]{10}$` reject punctuation (→ 400), `BuildOwner` does no stripping, and `DuplicateKey` does not remove punctuation. `AcceptanceBase.java` helpers: `uniqueTelephone()` → `String.format("2%09d", seq())` (unique 10-digit starting with 2), `ownerNode()` builds a fully valid/unique owner JSON, `createOwner`/`createOwnerOk` POST to `/api/owners`, `getOwner` GETs `/api/owners/{id}`.

**Unit test:** `/home/daniel/.../src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/DuplicateKeyTest.java` — verifies `DuplicateKey` case/whitespace normalization and null/blank handling (no punctuation cases).

**Controller test:** `/home/daniel/.../src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1Tests.java` — `createOwnerDuplicateConflict()` (409 on duplicate telephone), plus create/validation cases using telephone `6085551023` / `6081234567`.

---

## Key takeaways for making changes

- Telephone uniqueness on **create** already exists (`EnsureOwnerUnique` + `DuplicateKey`), wired only in `owners.POST.yml`.
- **PUT (`{ownerId}.PUT.yml`) has no uniqueness step** — if update must also enforce telephone uniqueness, you'd add an `ensureUnique`-style function to that chain (and it would need to exclude the owner being updated, unlike the create-time check).
- **`Cp11Tests` (digits-only storage + punctuation-normalized dedupe) is not satisfied** by current code: the DTO pattern (`^[0-9]*$`), entity pattern (`^[0-9]{10}$`), `BuildOwner`, and `DuplicateKey` would all need changes to strip non-digits before validation/storage/comparison.
- `DuplicateKey` is the shared normalization point for both telephone and email dedupe — changing it affects both.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner

      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:

## Summary

The change makes telephone numbers stored as digits only, returns the stored value in the `telephone` field, and normalizes before the uniqueness check. Three coordinated edits:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — relaxed the `OwnerFieldsDto` telephone pattern from `^[0-9]*$` to `^[0-9 ()-]*$`. This was necessary because the request DTO is bean-validated (`@Valid`) *before* any normalization runs, so punctuated input like `(613) 555-0100` would otherwise be rejected as a 400 before it could be stripped. The `Owner` entity's `^[0-9]{10}$` constraint still runs on persist, so the *stored* value is guaranteed to be exactly 10 digits.

2. **`.../rest/function/owner/Telephone.java`** (new) — a small package-private helper, `Telephone.normalize(...)`, that strips spaces, dashes and parentheses (mirroring the existing `DuplicateKey` helper style).

3. **`BuildOwner.java` (POST)** and **`ApplyOwner.java` (PUT)** — normalize the telephone before setting it on the entity. In the POST pipeline `build → ensureUnique → … → save`, normalizing in `BuildOwner` means both the uniqueness check (`EnsureOwnerUnique`) and storage see the digits-only value, so `(613) 555-0100` and `6135550100` collide (409) and the stored/returned value is `6135550100`.

I left `DuplicateKey` untouched since it's shared with the email-uniqueness check; because normalization happens upstream in `BuildOwner`, the existing comparison logic works unchanged.

Both `Cp11Tests` cases (`coreStoresDigitsOnly`, `functionalityNormalisedDuplicateRejected`) now pass, and no existing test regressed.
